purpose: Teach: 多かれ/暮し/所々/苛立ち/うかがえる/真中/縮め/探し出し

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、人は多かれ少なかれ嘘をつくものさ
lines.en: Riku — people lie, more or less. It's just what happens.
lines.style: Dry, knowing half-smile. Quick rhythm on the observation. Light and settling, like she's stating a fact everyone already knows but won't say out loud.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、一人暮しのアパート快適か?桜
lines.en: You living alone in that apartment — is it actually comfortable?
lines.style: Straightforward question, genuine curiosity underneath. Casual delivery but the pause before 'comfortable' shows he's asking about more than just the space.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のノート、所々破れてるな
lines.en: Your notebook's falling apart, by the way. Pages are ripped all over.
lines.style: Casual observation, but note-taking. Not accusatory — just stating what she sees. A beat of concern masked as matter-of-factness.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、最近苛立ちを表に出すな、桜
lines.en: You've been showing how frustrated you are lately. It's starting to show.
lines.style: Measured, direct. Not soft, not harsh — the tone of someone calling out something they've noticed building. A small lean forward in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の言葉から本音がうかがえる
lines.en: Your real feelings come through in what you say, Riku. Even when you try not to.
lines.style: Quiet, reflective. Slow pace. Warm without being gentle — the voice of someone who listens and sees. A small moment of honesty between them.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、教室の真中に座ってたな、桜
lines.en: You were sitting in the middle of the classroom the other day.
lines.style: Observational, casual. Light curiosity — noticing a small shift. Not pushing, just acknowledging he was somewhere different than usual.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、答えを縮めて書きすぎだぞ
lines.en: You're cutting your answers way too short on the homework. You know that, right?
lines.style: Slightly exasperated but affectionate. The rhythm picks up on 'way too short.' Not lecturing — more like a friend noticing a habit and gently calling it out.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、無くした財布を探し出してたな、桜
lines.en: You found that wallet someone lost. That took real attention.
lines.style: Warm, genuine praise. Slower pace. The voice of someone acknowledging something good they saw him do, without making it into a big moment. Quiet respect.
